parts.zh: M: 不好意思，你们的摇滚音乐区在哪里？
M: 哦，你们只有爵士音乐？没有别的吗？
W: 没错。我们是伦敦唯一一家专门经营爵士乐的唱片店
M: 那么，你会如何定义爵士乐？
W: 嗯，有趣的是，人们并没有对爵士乐达成统一的定义
M: 那如果你申请小一点的金额呢？也许你可以从其他渠道筹集资金
W: 你还没明白。不管我申请多大额度的贷款

items.stem: What do we learn about the woman's store?

choices.text: It focuses exclusively on jazz.
choices.zh: 它专门经营爵士乐。

choices.text: It sponsors major jazz concerts.
choices.zh: 它赞助大型爵士音乐会。

choices.text: It has several branches in London.
choices.zh: 它在伦敦有几家分店。

choices.text: It displays albums by new music talents.
choices.zh: 它展示新音乐人才的专辑。

items.stem: What does the man say about jazz music?

choices.text: It originated with cowboys.
choices.zh: 它起源于牛仔。

choices.text: Its market has now shrunk.
choices.zh: 它的市场现在已经萎缩。

choices.text: Its listeners are mostly young people.
choices.zh: 它的听众大多是年轻人。

choices.text: It remains as widespread as hip hop music.
choices.zh: 它仍然像嘻哈音乐一样普及。

items.stem: What does the woman say about jazz?

choices.text: Its definition is varied and complicated.
choices.zh: 它的定义多样且复杂。

choices.text: It is still going through experimentation.
choices.zh: 它仍在经历实验阶段。

choices.text: It is frequently accompanied by singing.
choices.zh: 它经常伴有歌唱。

choices.text: Its style has remained largely unchanged
choices.zh: 它的风格基本保持不变。

items.stem: What should you do to appreciate different styles of jazz according to the woman?

choices.text: Learn to play them.
choices.zh: 学习演奏它们。

choices.text: Take music lessons.
choices.zh: 上音乐课。

choices.text: Listen to them yourself.
choices.zh: 自己去听它们。

choices.text: Consult jazz musicians.
choices.zh: 咨询爵士音乐家。

items.stem: What did the woman do this morning?

choices.text: She paid her mortgage.
choices.zh: 她支付了抵押贷款。

choices.text: She called on the man.
choices.zh: 她拜访了这位男士。

choices.text: She made a business plan.
choices.zh: 她制定了一份商业计划。

choices.text: She went to the bank.
choices.zh: 她去了银行。

items.stem: Why was the woman's proposal rejected?

choices.text: Her previous debt hadn't been cleared yet.
choices.zh: 她之前的债务尚未清偿。

choices.text: Her credit history was considered poor.
choices.zh: 她的信用记录被认为较差。

choices.text: She had apparently asked for too much.
choices.zh: 她显然要求的金额过多。

choices.text: She didn't pay her mortgage in time.
choices.zh: 她没有按时支付抵押贷款。

items.stem: What is the woman planning to do?

choices.text: Pay a debt long overdue
choices.zh: 偿还一笔逾期很久的债务

choices.text: Buy a piece of property
choices.zh: 购买一处房产

choices.text: Start her own business
choices.zh: 创办自己的企业

choices.text: Check her credit history
choices.zh: 核查她的信用记录

items.stem: What does the man suggest the woman do?

choices.text: Seek advice from an expert about fundraising.
choices.zh: 就筹款事宜向专家寻求建议。

choices.text: Ask for smaller loans from different lenders.
choices.zh: 向不同的贷款方申请小额贷款。

choices.text: Build up her own finances step by step.
choices.zh: 逐步建立她自己的财务状况。

choices.text: Revise her business proposal carefully.
choices.zh: 仔细修改她的商业提案。

items.stem: What do we learn about Leo Sanchez's farm?

choices.text: It is profitable and environmentally friendly.
choices.zh: 它既盈利又环保。

choices.text: It is well located and completely automated.
choices.zh: 它地理位置优越且完全自动化。

choices.text: It is small and unconventional.
choices.zh: 它规模小且不走寻常路。

choices.text: It is fertile and productive.
choices.zh: 它土地肥沃且产量高。

items.stem: What has motivated Leo Sanchez and his fellow young farmers to engage in farming?

choices.text: Their urge to make farming more enjoyable.
choices.zh: 他们想让农业变得更有乐趣。

choices.text: Their desire to improve farming equipment.
choices.zh: 他们想改进农业设备。

choices.text: Their hope to revitalize traditional farming.
choices.zh: 他们希望振兴传统农业。

choices.text: Their wish to set a new farming standard.
choices.zh: 他们希望树立新的农业标准。

items.stem: Why did Leo Sanchez buy a hand-operated weeding tool?

choices.text: It saves a lot of electricity.
choices.zh: 它节省大量电力。

choices.text: It needs little maintenance.
choices.zh: 它几乎不需要维护。

choices.text: It causes hardly any pollution.
choices.zh: 它几乎不造成任何污染。

choices.text: It loosens soil while weeding.
choices.zh: 它在除草的同时疏松土壤。

items.stem: What do we learn from the passage about the food company Eat Grub?

choices.text: It has turned certain insects into a new food source.
choices.zh: 它已将某些昆虫转化为一种新的食物来源。

choices.text: It has started to expand business outside the UK.
choices.zh: 它已开始在英国以外扩展业务。

choices.text: It has imported some exotic foods from overseas.
choices.zh: 它已从海外进口了一些异国食品。

choices.text: It has joined hands with Sainsbury's to sell pet insects.
choices.zh: 它已与 Sainsbury's 携手销售宠物昆虫。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about his first bite of roasted crickets?

choices.text: It was really unforgettable.
choices.zh: 那真是令人难忘。

choices.text: It was a pleasant surprise.
choices.zh: 那是一个令人愉快的惊喜。

choices.text: It hurt his throat slightly.
choices.zh: 那使他的喉咙有点疼。

choices.text: It made him feel strange.
choices.zh: 那让他感觉很奇怪。

items.stem: What does Eat Grub say about its dried crickets?

choices.text: They are more tasty than beef, chicken or pork.
choices.zh: 它们比牛肉、鸡肉或猪肉更美味。

choices.text: They are more nutritious than soups and salads.
choices.zh: 它们比汤和沙拉更有营养。

choices.text: They contain more protein than conventional meats.
choices.zh: 它们比传统肉类含有更多蛋白质。

choices.text: They will soon gain popularity throughout the world.
choices.zh: 它们很快将在全世界流行起来。

items.stem: What does the passage say about insect farming?

choices.text: It is environmentally friendly.
choices.zh: 它是环保的。

choices.text: It is a promising industry.
choices.zh: 它是一个有前景的产业。

choices.text: It requires new technology.
choices.zh: 它需要新技术。

choices.text: It saves huge amounts of labour.
choices.zh: 它节省了大量劳动力。

items.stem: Why do psychologists and educators study learning styles?

choices.text: To categorize different types of learners.
choices.zh: 对不同类型的学习者进行分类。

choices.text: To find out what students prefer to learn.
choices.zh: 找出学生更喜欢学习什么。

choices.text: To understand the mechanism of the human brain.
choices.zh: 了解人类大脑的运作机制。

choices.text: To see if they are inherent traits affecting learning.
choices.zh: 看看学习风格是否是影响学习的固有特质。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about one study mentioned in the 2008 review?

choices.text: It was defective.
choices.zh: 它存在缺陷。

choices.text: It was misguided.
choices.zh: 它被误导了。

choices.text: It was original in design.
choices.zh: 它在设计上具有原创性。

choices.text: It was thought-provoking.
choices.zh: 它发人深省。

items.stem: What message does the speaker want to convey about learning at the end of the talk?

choices.text: Auditory aids are as important as visual aids.
choices.zh: 听觉辅助手段与视觉辅助手段同样重要。

choices.text: Visual aids are helpful to all types of learners.
choices.zh: 视觉辅助手段对所有类型的学习者都有帮助。

choices.text: Reading plain texts is more effective than viewing pictures.
choices.zh: 阅读纯文本比观看图片更有效。

choices.text: Scientific concepts are hard to understand without visual aids.
choices.zh: 没有视觉辅助手段,科学概念很难理解。

items.stem: What do people often feel guilty about according to the speaker?

choices.text: Not playing a role in a workplace revolution.
choices.zh: 没有在职场革命中发挥作用。

choices.text: Not benefiting from free-market capitalism.
choices.zh: 没有从自由市场资本主义中受益。

choices.text: Not earning enough money to provide for the family.
choices.zh: 没有赚到足够的钱来养家糊口。

choices.text: Not spending enough time on family life and leisure.
choices.zh: 没有在家庭生活和休闲上花足够的时间。

items.stem: What did leading economists predict 90 years ago?

choices.text: People would be working only fifteen hours a week now.
choices.zh: 现在人们每周只需工作十五小时。

choices.text: The balance of power in the workplace would change.
choices.zh: 职场的权力平衡将会改变。

choices.text: Technological advances would create many new jobs.
choices.zh: 技术进步将创造许多新的工作岗位。

choices.text: Most workers could afford to have a house of their own
choices.zh: 大多数工人能够负担得起拥有自己的房子。

items.stem: What is the result of denying workers' right to make their own choices?

choices.text: Loss of workers' personal dignity.
choices.zh: 工人个人尊严的丧失。

choices.text: Deprivation of workers' creativity.
choices.zh: 工人创造力的剥夺。

choices.text: Deterioration of workers' mental health.
choices.zh: 工人心理健康的恶化。

choices.text: Unequal distribution of working hours.
choices.zh: 工作时间分配不均。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the dream airport in Berlin?

choices.text: It is the worst managed airport in German history.
choices.zh: 它是德国历史上管理最差的机场。

choices.text: It is now the biggest and busiest airport in Europe.
choices.zh: 它现在是欧洲最大、最繁忙的机场。

choices.text: It has become something of a joke among Germans.
choices.zh: 它在德国人中已成为某种笑话。

choices.text: It has become a typical symbol of German efficiency.
choices.zh: 它已成为德国效率的典型象征。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the dream airport in Berlin?

choices.text: The city's airports are outdated.
choices.zh: 该市的机场已经过时。

choices.text: The city had just been reunified.
choices.zh: 该市刚刚完成统一。

choices.text: The city wanted to boost its economy.
choices.zh: 该市想要促进经济发展。

choices.text: The city wanted to attract more tourists.
choices.zh: 该市想要吸引更多游客。

items.stem: Why did Berlin postpone the opening of its dream airport again and again?

choices.text: The municipal government kept changing hands.
choices.zh: 市政府不断更迭。

choices.text: The construction firm breached the contract.
choices.zh: 建筑公司违反了合同。

choices.text: Shortage of funding delayed its construction.
choices.zh: 资金短缺延误了建设。

choices.text: Problems of different kinds kept popping up.
choices.zh: 各种各样的问题不断出现。

items.stem: What happens while the airport remains unused?

choices.text: Tourism industry in Berlin suffers.
choices.zh: 柏林的旅游业受到损害。

choices.text: All kinds of equipment gets rusted.
choices.zh: 各种设备生锈。

choices.text: Huge maintenance costs accumulate.
choices.zh: 巨额维护成本不断累积。

choices.text: Complaints by local residents increase.
choices.zh: 当地居民的投诉增加。
